status: Working hypotheses and scoped independent local checks. Formal two-leg review outstanding.

assumptions_and_derivation.constitutive_status: The native order balance leaves the material energy partners open. The scalar bare order potential has equal endpoint energies. The earlier resonant receiver on an isolated site has no angular link. Coupling a loop phase to a transiting parcel is a new constitutive choice. The tag denotes a compatible energy-gap receiver in the bulk, or the calibrated internal departure measurement. A maintained port and fresh incoming preparations are assumptions.
assumptions_and_derivation.throughput: Use an equal-speed forward dispersion v p over the occupied bandwidth, v=1, positive incident kinetic energy 10, hbar=1, transit time T=1 and gap=1. No backward channels or drift-velocity dispersion. One fixed-mark parcel has incoming rho=I_3/3 times spin-up and h0=I_3 times (1-sigma_z)/2. In the spatial interaction region h=h0+diag(-2 p_i.sigma)+spin-blind nearest hopping -t; t=1 with a phase exp(-iF) on matrix element (2,0). Neither the mouth nor any parcel is rotated bodily. An energy-conserving readout can swap the extra internal excitation to an equally spaced stationary receiver. Only energy differences are counted.
assumptions_and_derivation.energy_account: Tag=tr h0(S rho S^dag-rho), S=exp(-ihT), fixed lab frames at inlet and outlet. Interface drift changes at entry and exit are -tr[(h-h0)rho] and +tr[(h-h0)S rho S^dag]. Their sum plus the tag vanishes at fixed F. The one-pass impulse J=-integral tr[rho(t) partial_F h]dt=-i tr[rho S^dag partial_F S]. Positive work goes into the angular coordinate. For moving F, tag plus drift equals mechanical work on the parcel. A twist-dependent common site energy alters the force without changing the held tag.
assumptions_and_derivation.geometry: The seven-cut orientation preparation uses the earlier six contacts with excited retention r=0.797560166355 per contact. One exposed cut has 128 or 512 oriented triangular faces. Plus normals rotated by (.26,-.19,.17) radians as a rotation vector. The mirror uses antipodal points and reversed outward face ordering with the same reservoir preparation. Each parcel visits one face f at rate D*w_f with D=0.25 and w_f=solid angle/(4*pi). Average equally over three possible marked bonds per face. The effective coupling conveys each face's total phase to its marked contact, including during motion. Direct microscopic redistribution of a time-varying phase among separate contacts could have different dynamics.
assumptions_and_derivation.flux_and_period: A twist of one real edge changes two oriented face angles oppositely. For final principal angles 2*pi*q*w_f on the sphere use opposite unwrapped return -2*pi*q on a single face. Work from flat equals sum_f D*w_f int_0^(2*pi*q*w_f) J_f dF - q*D*w_j*oint J_j dF. In the equal scalar-site model, choose A=(diag(1,-1,1) tensor i sigma_y)K. For the given constant centroid h(pi-F)=I-Ah(F)A^-1. The beam complementary to rho_up has J_down=-J_up because det S is independent of F. Combining with the antiunitary yields J_up(pi-F)=-J_up(F) per mark. The work over every full turn vanishes. At fixed face rates, independent of all other phases, each face integral is then a periodic single-valued function. This quasistatic fact is separate from damping in a time-dependent experiment.
assumptions_and_derivation.bounds: The eigenvalues of partial_F h are t,t,0,0,-t,-t. Tracing over three equally occupied orthogonal incoming states gives |J_f|<=2tT/3. Write A=2DtT/3 and C=collar energy on seven layers. For principal angles on the driven rim C>=K*c*sum phi_f^2, with W(F)=8 sin^2(F/8), c=W(pi)/pi^2 and K=1/s, s=R/R0. B=A^2*sum w_f^2/(4Kc). In the zero-period gate W_conv<=2 sqrt(BC) for all endpoints. A nonzero sector has C>=Cmin=K*min(W(pi),5W(2pi/5),7 N W(2pi/N)). With B<Cmin, Eext+Cmin-2 sqrt(B Cmin)-Uwave bounds the energy still needed. Eext=pi/(32s). Uwave is the prior upper bound for fixed frequency-ranked actions in bound modes, under its wave-only axial load at fixed geometry. Add wave and converter only for separately counted populations coupled to the same coordinate in common energy units. Identifying our gap/hopping units with the prior material and exterior energy units is a new calibration assumption. No extra parcel force is credited to the original axial support load.
assumptions_and_derivation.first_crossing: Before the first collar face reaches |phi|=pi all face lifts from flat lie in a single branch. Even with unequal static site energies, |work_f|<=A*w_f*|phi_f| as long as rates, prepared material and dwell stay fixed; other face motions leave this impulse unchanged. At the first half-turn pay at least K W(pi). Spend at most pi A max(w_f) on the crossing face and bound the other face work minus their cost by B. Dropping the exterior cost gives the first-slip deficit K W(pi)-pi A max(w_f)-B-Uwave. For an undriven first crossing its first work allowance can be omitted. This blocks a quasistatic transition from a flat resting state using only these mean forces at the stated parameters; it does not bound a driven formed defect, stochastic escapes, memory-dependent work or arbitrary dynamical instabilities.
assumptions_and_derivation.cycles: For F=A0 cos(omega t), compute linear response from a stationary population of all transit ages. Positive W means energy into the field. Independent finite-amplitude integration evolves each of 24 entering phases through the interaction and accounts separately for drift, excitation and work. Five frequencies with omega*T=.25,1,2,4,8 and a selected link on the coarse sphere, plus a calibration triad. No spectrum-wide stability or continuum extrapolation.
assumptions_and_derivation.retained_energy_hypothesis: Add a static scalar b_i=beta*e_i at each site, common to both internal states. Use e_i=(1-r^6)(1-eta*n_iz)/2, the accumulated mean quanta deposited into separate receivers during prior preparation. Assuming the site retains a reproducible shift proportional to that history is extra physics, with cutoff/saturation or recharge dynamics unselected. For independent face impulses, turning one edge once does signed work sum_f incidence_fe D w_f oint J_f dF. A cycle can run on replenished parcel drift in one imposed sense and require work in the other. The externally completed turn returns the compact field to its initial configuration. Its work does not say that an exterior unit was formed. Independent Wolfram isolated-triad control uses an alternative b_i=(3/4) p_iz^2.
assumptions_and_derivation.independent_patch_readout: Block all hopping, compare before/after deposition against the same coherent external phase reference at equal dwell, and resolve both internal channels. Half the continuously unwrapped argument of det(S_before^dag S_after) measures -beta (e_after-e_before) T/hbar even if the traceless onsite spin rotation changes. The isolated transition splitting cannot determine a common shift. Both phase preparation and reference propagation must be calibrated. Synthetic data from the hypothesized shift are an identifiability check, not an inferred real material coefficient.
assumptions_and_derivation.native_resonant_control: Direct test of the earlier resonant site interaction using its actual full_block matrix in the equal free evolution interaction picture. One interferometer arm bypasses the interaction. For a fresh unrelated probe and receiver marginal rho_B, M=Tr_B[U(I tensor rho_B)] is the observed coherence amplitude; it need not be unitary. Its determinant relative to the fresh reference is measured in both channels. In the local pin basis the coupling connects only |e,0> to a single bright |g,w> with amplitude sqrt(2)g. All even powers of the interaction are spin diagonal and the odd powers spin off diagonal. Thus M has real diagonal a,d and off diagonal x,-x*. For sqrt(2)|g|T<pi/2, cos(VT)>0 so a,d>0 for any receiver state and det M=ad+|x|^2>0. The native contact gives zero continuous common phase in that regime. To test stored energy, use a new independent probe with the marginal of the receiver from encounter six after tracing the earlier parcel, on both mirrors. Its stored population differs from the cumulative deposition used in the mesh law. Also test an explicitly coherent receiver and a common shift beta*tr(rho_exc). No test identifies the reduced two-state variable with light or with a physical electric charge.
assumptions_and_derivation.method_reference: A related general scattering-matrix formulation of adiabatic reaction forces appears in Bode et al., https://doi.org/10.3762/bjnano.3.15 . The proposed mouth law and its consequences above follow from the local Hamiltonians in this record.
